title: Implement readiness state machine in control plane (Allocated→Provisioning→Validating→Ready/Quarantined)
creator: Ethan Park
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Goal
Implement the canonical readiness state machine in the control plane so provisioning automation (fleet/orchestrator + validation agent) has a single source of truth for: (a) current readiness state, (b) transition history, and (c) failure reasons/artifacts. This unblocks gating nodes before they can join serving pools and enables dashboards/SLOs.

References
- ADR: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-017-provision-to-ready-readiness-state-machine.json
- Service context: sources/confluence/eng-platform/systems-and-services/fleet-readiness-service.json
- Early API notes: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/platform-engineering/fleet-readiness-api-proto-notes.json

Scope
1) Data model + persistence
- Add tables to control-plane DB:
  - fleet_node_readiness (current state)
  - fleet_node_readiness_events (append-only transition/event log)
  - fleet_node_validation_summary (latest per-step results; pointers to artifacts)
- Ensure indexes support common queries: pool_id, region, gpu_type, state, updated_at.
- Retention: keep events 30d by default (configurable) to support SLI computations + incident review.

2) State machine + invariants
Canonical states (per ADR): Allocated, Provisioning, Validating, Ready, Quarantined.
- Only allow forward transitions except:
  - Ready → Provisioning allowed ONLY via explicit operator action (reimage / reprovision), with audit trail
  - Quarantined → Provisioning allowed ONLY via explicit operator action (override), with audit trail
- Enforce allowed transitions at write time.
- Idempotency: repeated writes of same state must be safe (no-op with updated_at bump optional) and must not duplicate events unless transition is new.

3) Authoritative signals (per ADR)
- Control plane is authoritative for current state.
- Orchestrator writes transitions to Provisioning/Validating/Ready/Quarantined.
- Validation agent reports per-check results (health/driver/network/storage/NCCL/smoke canary) to control plane via orchestrator (not direct agent→DB).
- Heartbeat: store latest agent/orchestrator heartbeat timestamp for “stuck in Validating/Provisioning” detection (used by SRE tooling; not a hard gating signal yet).

4) API endpoints (internal)
- POST /internal/fleet/readiness/nodes/{node_id}/transition
  - body: from_state, to_state, reason_code, message, actor (service principal), correlation_id
  - validates allowed transitions and from_state matches current unless force=true (force restricted)
- POST /internal/fleet/readiness/nodes/{node_id}/validation-result
  - step_name, status (pass/fail/skip), duration_ms, metrics (sanitized), artifacts_uri, error_signature
- GET /internal/fleet/readiness/nodes/{node_id}
  - returns current state + latest validation summary + last_transition_at + failure_reason
- GET /internal/fleet/readiness/pools/{pool_id}/summary
  - counts by state + top failure reasons (bounded list)

5) Telemetry
- Emit events to internal bus for SLI computation and dashboards:
  - readiness.state_changed
  - readiness.validation_step_completed
- Metrics (no per-node cardinality):
  - fleet_readiness_transitions_total{from,to,region,gpu_type,pool_tier}
  - fleet_readiness_state_gauge{state,region,gpu_type,pool_tier}
  - fleet_validation_failures_total{step,reason_code,region,gpu_type}
- Ensure tags do not include node_id, instance_id, or raw error strings.

Acceptance criteria
- State machine enforced with unit tests covering all allowed/disallowed transitions.
- New DB schema deployed with forward-only migrations + rollback plan.
- APIs available behind feature flag and service authz.
- Transition/event log is populated for all state changes, including operator overrides.
- Failure reasons stored in structured format (reason_code + message), with artifact URIs for deeper triage.
- Ready/Quarantined states are queryable by pool and used by internal tooling without expensive scans.

Notes / design decisions
- We are storing “current state” + “append-only events” (not full event sourcing) per ADR discussion. Rationale: simple reads for operators + sufficient history for SLI and incident review.
- Force transitions are restricted to oncall/operator role and must always create an audit event.

Implementation plan
- Phase 1: DB migrations + model layer + transition validator.
- Phase 2: Internal APIs with authz + structured error codes.
- Phase 3: Telemetry + pool summary endpoint for internal console.

Risks
- Cardinality blowups from tagging with node identifiers → explicitly disallowed; add lint in metrics helper.
- Race conditions (orchestrator retries) → require optimistic concurrency (compare current_state) unless force.

Link to code
- Control-plane PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-18421-add-fleet-readiness-states-and-api.json
- Validation artifacts PR (follow-up but part of the plan): sources/github/redwood/pr-18429-record-validation-artifacts-and-failure-reasons.json
